goal: Set up CalHack on this Mac

steps.title: Install the Droid helper program
steps.explanation: Installs the Droid program from Homebrew. CalHack uses it to run approved fixes on your Mac. You also need to add a key to a settings file afterwards.
concerns: Gives the app power to run commands on your Mac

steps.title: Install the project's code libraries
steps.explanation: Downloads the extra code this app needs to run. This is the first setup step.

steps.title: Download the Electron app framework
steps.explanation: Downloads the framework the app is built on. It only needs to happen once.

steps.title: Create your settings file
steps.explanation: Makes a private settings file from the example. Then open it and paste in your own key from the Anthropic website.
concerns: Your API key is private; never share this file

steps.title: Optional: set up the local voice (about 340 MB)
steps.explanation: Downloads a voice that speaks on your Mac without the internet. Skip this if you do not need spoken replies. It only needs to happen once.
concerns: Downloads a large file of about 340 MB

steps.title: Start the demo pages
steps.explanation: Starts the practice web pages on this Mac. Keep this Terminal window open.

steps.title: Start the CalHack app
steps.explanation: Opens CalHack. Use a second Terminal window for this, while the demo pages keep running. A small shield icon appears in the menu bar when it works.
